scenarios.description: A stage with five log entries, none with conditions, each with a result script (ControlRumble stage 0, allow repeated stages): which entries' result scripts SetStage runs. In-game capture on save nvftest. Input parity-lab/inputs/layer5/quest2_multi_entry_stage.actions.json (fnv.script.actions/1 with the round 2 additions, docs/spec-notes/layer5-captures.md sections 4 and 8); fnvtool script run errors on the additions until workstream 5B implements them.

Condition lists mixing AND and OR, observed through AI package choice: the Goodsprings settlers' flee package (A OR B AND C) and Sunny Smiles' stay package (A AND B AND C OR D OR E), with quest variables, stages and an objective set to cases where the groupings differ. In-game capture on save nvftest. Input parity-lab/inputs/layer5/quest2_condition_groups.actions.json (fnv.script.actions/1 with the round 2 additions, docs/spec-notes/layer5-captures.md sections 4 and 8); fnvtool script run errors on the additions until workstream 5B implements them.

A quest script with ElseIf markers after their If chain was closed by EndIf (BeatrixFX, FalloutNV SCPT 0x0017B778): the successive values of the variable the stray branches set, and the quest's state after its script stopped it. In-game capture on save nvftest. Input parity-lab/inputs/layer5/quest2_stray_elseif.actions.json (fnv.script.actions/1 with the round 2 additions, docs/spec-notes/layer5-captures.md sections 4 and 8); fnvtool script run errors on the additions until workstream 5B implements them.

Scripted Activate of dead and living actors with and without the run-OnActivate flag: a dead actor whose OnActivate never calls Activate, one without an OnActivate block, and the Techatticup hostages (FalloutNV SCPT 0x00123191, whose only Activate follows a stray ElseIf); observed by the container menu and a quest variable. In-game capture on save nvftest. Input parity-lab/inputs/layer5/quest2_dead_activation.actions.json (fnv.script.actions/1 with the round 2 additions, docs/spec-notes/layer5-captures.md sections 4 and 8); fnvtool script run errors on the additions until workstream 5B implements them.

A door's OnActivate writes another reference's object-script variable (DocMitchellREF.PlayerLeft) and then activates: scripted Activate with and without the flag, the variable read in the activating script and afterwards. In-game capture on save nvfdoc. Input parity-lab/inputs/layer5/quest2_ref_activation.actions.json (fnv.script.actions/1 with the round 2 additions, docs/spec-notes/layer5-captures.md sections 4 and 8); fnvtool script run errors on the additions until workstream 5B implements them.

An item's OnAdd and GameMode blocks (JarPistolPowder): item counts in the script that added it and on the following frames. In-game capture on save nvftest. Input parity-lab/inputs/layer5/quest2_onadd_gamemode.actions.json (fnv.script.actions/1 with the round 2 additions, docs/spec-notes/layer5-captures.md sections 4 and 8); fnvtool script run errors on the additions until workstream 5B implements them.

GetSecondsPassed countdowns of two quest scripts (VCG00 every frame with a MenuMode block, VMQ03aTimer every 0.5 s) after a container menu held open for 900 frames: the first drop after the menu (compared within 0.05 s).
